# Changelog v0.10.1

Release Date: 2026-10-22

## Compatibility

- Released with the cli train. The optional `@qvac/cli` peer moves to `^0.17.0`.
- Raise the `@ai-sdk/provider` floor to `^4.0.10` and `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` to `^5.0.35`, the first versions with the `FilesV4` stream types the provider builds against. (see PR [#5215](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/5215))
